label: Desk Unsloth
description: The local agent's mediator (goal/G10.3): routes between the model at the connection's url and Andy's desk through this node's deskClient, answering the lines addressed to its persona and JOB lines, the call built fresh from the desk each time. Its two files are in its state folder: configuration.json (persona, preamble, model, contextLimit, answerTokens, bytesPerToken) and connection.json (url, key). Since goal/G14.2 it has a switch: connect {on} stops or resumes its asks for lines (off says signoff to the desk, so the persona leaves the live list at once), and state {} says whether it is connected, with its persona and model; deskUnslothRemote flips and reads them. Since goal/G14.4 it also reads the studio for the app: models {} (the cached models with their quant, size, task, loaded flag and vision/reasoning/audio), model.load {id} (the studio loads it and the configuration's model follows), and the chat box's two asks, chat.send {lines} answering an id at once and chat.answer {id} answering the model's text when done. It keeps one state object and publishes it on every change (goal/G14.5). Since goal/G14.6 the model has the tools the node describes to agents (tools.js: the introspection turned into OpenAI tools, a tool call run through the node), the first being net.fetch.
